answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should treat each new identity as a bonded stake, not a free fable of uniqueness. Require a deposit that unlocks only after many epochs of attested work; that bond is the anchor peers use when grading. Soft reputation feels like velvet—easy to polish with spam—so discard it and settle on burnable stake plus attestation density. Cloned identities share one bond, so flooding collapses their own collateral before they harvest rewards.
